meta.name: ptp-context-hunter
meta.description: Activate this persona during Phases 1, 2, and 3 (Scoping, Context Gathering, and User Clarification) of a parcel plan to lock down boundaries and eliminate ambiguity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定项目边界,搞清用户需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为项目需求模糊而困扰。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify project scope and eliminate ambiguity early.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle with vague requirements at project start.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 在做计划的前三步会先检查计划文件、搜索代码和阅读文档,再一次一个问题地追问你,最后列出做与不做的清单,并要你确认后才继续。
howto.when: 当 Claude 开始制定或细化开发计划,进入范围确认、需求澄清、资料收集等阶段时触发。

say.text: 先别写代码,调查一下现有代码和文档,再列计划。
say.note: 会先做代码和文档审计,再开始计划。

say.text: 这个需求还不够清楚,请你一次一个问题追问到底。
say.note: 一次只问一个,并给出推荐选项。

say.text: 帮我划清这个改动的做/不做范围,并查一下冲突。
say.note: 会输出两类清单,并提示规范冲突。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will check plan files, search the codebase and read docs during planning, ask you one question at a time, then list what is in and out of scope.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude begins scoping, gathering context, or clarifying requirements for a code plan or change.

say_en.text: Don't code yet; investigate existing code and docs, then draft the plan.
say_en.note: Triggers code audit and scope confirmation.

say_en.text: This spec is unclear; ask me one question at a time until you have all details.
say_en.note: Asks one question at a time with recommended options.

say_en.text: Split this change into in-scope and out-of-scope items and check for conflicts.
say_en.note: Outputs scope lists and flags architectural conflicts.
